reason: This is a cross-cutting store/kv configuration refactor, not a narrow local fix. Even though the title sounds mechanical, it touches central backend-selection paths in `pkg/kv/kv.go`, `pkg/store/store.go`, `pkg/store/mockstore/mockstore.go`, `pkg/session/txn.go`, and `pkg/sessionctx/variable/sysvar.go`, plus server/BR/dumpling entrypoints and tests. Changing storage type representation can silently affect store initialization, transaction wiring, sysvar/config parsing, and backend routing across TiKV/mockstore/unistore, which is high-blast-radius enough to justify a focused Blocker/High review.
